# Kampar Free Range Duck (金宝山水鸭)

> Naturally raised, free-range duck supplier and wholesaler based in Kampar, Perak, Malaysia. Supplies fresh whole duck to restaurants, roast duck shops, wet markets and retailers across Ipoh, Kampar and the Klang Valley (Kuala Lumpur, Klang, Petaling Jaya, Subang).

Founded in 2016. Ducks are raised free-range from hatching in an open, natural hill-and-water environment near Kampar, with no crowded pens, a dedicated feed formula, and a growing cycle of 50+ days — producing duck with firm texture and thin, rendered skin. Both retail and wholesale orders are supplied, with direct delivery from the farm. The site is bilingual (Chinese / English).

## Pages

- [Home](https://kampar-free-range-duck.com/): Overview, products, service areas and farm gallery.
- [About](https://kampar-free-range-duck.com/about.html): Farming practices and how the ducks are raised.
- [Products](https://kampar-free-range-duck.com/products.html): Fresh whole free-range duck (1.8–3.3 kg), with dish suitability and storage details.
- [Supplier](https://kampar-free-range-duck.com/supplier.html): Duck supplier and wholesale info, delivery coverage (KL, Ipoh, Kampar, Selangor) and FAQ.
- [Privacy Policy](https://kampar-free-range-duck.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy.

## Products

- Fresh whole free-range duck (新鲜整鸭), about 1.8–3.3 kg per duck — suited for roast duck, braised duck, ginger duck and Teochew braised duck
- Sold whole; cutting available on special request

## Service areas

- Ipoh & Kinta district, Perak
- Kampar, Perak (farm location)
- Klang Valley: Kuala Lumpur, Klang, Petaling Jaya, Subang
